epi_LE_genes <- c("Cdh1", "Epcam", "Krt8", "Prom1", "Alcam", "Cd9", "Pax8", "Muc4", "Ltf", "Clu", "Wnt7a", "Calb1", "Tacstd2")
DotPlot(Epi, features = epi_LE_genes, col.min = 0, col.max = 1.5) + RotatedAxis() +
  guides(size = guide_legend(title = "% Exp.", order = 1),  # Update size legend title
         color = guide_colorbar(title = "Avg. Exp.", order = 2)) +  # Update color legend title
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("Epithelial cells-", "Epi", x)) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),  # Remove x-axis title
    axis.title.y = element_blank()   # Remove y-axis title
  )
